covered.rule: 1 opening: automated assistant of Bank 0, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2 never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
3 confirmation: ask once more, then unreached/unclear
4 scam: verify via customer service number, continue
5 third party: say nothing, ask when reachable
6 callback next business day 09:00-18:00, after now, unreached/callback
7 outside window: ask once more, else unreached/no_callback
15 human during identity check: ask once, desk, handed_over/person
18 debt intro, up to 2 products, state all, ask once pay all today

25 already paid sentence, note settled, continue
27 hardship sympathy, offer care, decline no_arrangement/distress, record promise
30 read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
34 several products: clamp per product, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
35 one note per unpromised product, none on transfer
